messages.subject: Michele Tobias' DSI workshop this Friday: Projections for Spatial Data
parts:
Hi All,

Happy Presidents Day! I wanted to let everyone know about a DSI workshop happening later this week by Michele Tobias (the University Library's GIS curator) entitled "Projections for Spatial Data in R." The workshop will be on Friday, Feb. 23rd from 9:30-12 in 360 Shields Library, please register with this link. 

Here's a quick description of the workshop: 

If you’ve ever worked with spatial data, you’ve had one of those moments – two datasets that are for the same geographic location show up in two different countries in a map or you run a spatial analysis process and come up with an empty result. Why? The answer often has to do with projections. In this workshop, we’ll clarify some of the mysteries of working with projections and discuss how to avoid common mistakes. For hands-on experience, we’ll work with R, but the concepts will apply to any GIS tool or spatial database.  

Have a great day off, and hope to see you all there!

Best,

Martha (one of the D-RUG coordinators)
